title: The case that shows why you keep measuring.
summary: 2.3 million conversations in the first month; resolution 11 minutes to under 2; repeat inquiries down 25%.

spec.problem: Chat resolution averaged 11 minutes. Non-engineering hiring was frozen.
spec.changed: An assistant handling refunds, returns, payments and disputes launched in the app across 23 markets in January 2024.
spec.measured: Conversation volume, resolution time, repeat inquiries, satisfaction, headcount equivalent.
spec.result: **2.3 million conversations in the first month; resolution 11 minutes to under 2; repeat inquiries down 25%.** In May 2025 the CEO said quality had fallen and Klarna began rehiring human agents. Company-reported; use both halves.[^23]

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
